verdict.rationale: The only deprecation evidence covers legacy router API endpoints, not hosted models. It promises backward compatibility and removal "in a future release" but gives no dated notice period. The pack states that no standalone versioning policy document or changelog exists. Dated model snapshots and the model catalog feed are adjacent features; neither is a documented model-removal policy with advance notice.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice before a hosted model is removed
